scope: Exact new migration in isolated PGlite with copied ticket-access helpers and fixture auth/profile permission checks. Not live sign-in or actual Storage API upload evidence.
checks: allows incomplete cleanup draft before evidence capture
saves separate cleanup and damage drafts on the same ticket
rejects stale writes across devices
retries exact saved content without another revision
retains identifier leading zeros
rejects a second draft for the same form kind
rejects malformed and forged choices even in drafts
rejects unknown fields
rejects invalid date
rejects damage fields in cleanup
requires complete fields and four photo views at submission
lighting changes no longer require a map
invalid map coordinates are rejected
used customer transfers need every row value
assigned driver can read but cannot edit assessor forms
assigned team lead can read records
team lead cannot bypass assessor write scope
unrelated staff cannot read or edit another team ticket
authorized chief can edit the saved draft
assessment-view denial hides official records
unuploaded or wrong-ticket evidence cannot submit
submits linked uploaded GPS evidence and binds identity
submitted retry returns the same immutable version
submitted form edits are rejected
new revisions can start without overwriting prior submissions
submitted Entergy originals and thumbnails cannot be overwritten
submitted photo metadata is immutable
section damage needs its own linked photo
mismatched section evidence is rejected
photo checksum must match stored metadata
cross-ticket identity cannot be reused
authenticated users cannot write directly around RPC validation
inactive assessor loses all read and write access
anonymous roles cannot read or invoke the form RPC
saves and submissions emit server-bound audit events
